audit.scope: Environment variables, API keys, and security configurations

high.title: Hardcoded MIGRATIONS_API_KEY in production configuration
high.description: Found hardcoded migrations API key in .env.vercel.production file
high.impact: Production database migration endpoint could be compromised
high.recommendation: Move MIGRATIONS_API_KEY to Vercel environment variables and remove from file

medium.title: Debug endpoint accessible in production
medium.description: Debug endpoint at /api/debug exposes sensitive environment information
medium.recommendation: Ensure ENABLE_DEBUG_ENDPOINT is false in production

medium.title: Console log statements found in production code
medium.description: Multiple console.log statements found that could leak sensitive information
medium.impact: Potential information leakage in browser console
medium.recommendation: Remove or replace with proper logging in production builds

low.title: SQL endpoint exists with production safety check
low.description: Direct SQL execution endpoint exists but is properly protected
low.recommendation: Ensure ENABLE_SQL_ENDPOINT is never set to true in production
